editorial: While productivity-focused optimizations of AI models with developer tools are coming to the fore today, critical criticisms regarding security vulnerabilities are defining the agenda. The certificate security discussion shared on Hacker News and the release of new models like DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash clearly reveal current priorities in system architecture.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail
items.summary: ThinkRail, developed by JetBrains, is an agentic integrated development environment (IDE) that customizes itself according to the user's working style and improves its capabilities over time by learning project requirements. Prepared with TypeScript, this tool aims to support the software development process with a personalized experience.

snapshot.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need. ThinkRail is the agentic IDE that gets better every time you use it — learning your project through living specs today, and building its own capabilities tomorrow.

items.title: elayadesign/ai-design-skills
items.summary: elayadesign/ai-design-skills is a collection of design skills prepared for markdown rule files that can be read by coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Windsurf. This resource offers a set of guidelines aimed at increasing the functionality of AI-powered coding tools in design processes.

snapshot.description: A growing collection of design skills for AI coding tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and anything else that reads a markdown rules file.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: obra/superpowers is a capability framework and software development methodology developed for AI agents that code. It aims to standardize software processes for agents through composable skills and prompting instructions.

snapshot.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.summary: HKUDS/DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that combines processes such as tutoring, problem-solving, exam creation, and visualization into a single system. Developed with Python, this system aims to provide a personalized education experience focused on lifelong learning.

snapshot.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, problem solving, quiz generation, research, visualization, and mastery practice in one extensible system.

items.title: macro-inc/macro
items.summary: Macro is a platform that combines tools such as email, chat, documents, task management, AI agents, calls, and customer relationship management (CRM) into a single workspace. It aims to facilitate team collaboration by connecting all these workflows through a shared AI memory.

snapshot.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.summary: Nutlope/hallmark offers a design skill focused on preventing designs that appear to be created by generative AI on code editing tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. This tool aims to create a more authentic design language by excluding visual outputs that give the impression of being AI-generated.

snapshot.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.summary: Developed in the Rust language, impeccable offers a design vocabulary for AI agents that code. It provides auditing and review tools to improve quality in software processes and prevent AI-generated errors (AI slop).

snapshot.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.

items.title: makecindy/cindy
items.summary: Cindy is an open-source AI agent that can integrate with computers and phones. It allows users to connect their existing models and subscriptions to create a digital assistant suited to their work habits.

snapshot.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。. Cindy is an open-source AI agent, ready out of the box and yours to shape. Connect your computers and phone, bring the models and subscriptions you already use, and build a companion that knows how you like to work.

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot
items.summary: nightly-labs/openbot is a desktop application that allows you to manage AI models like Codex, Claude, and Grok on your local computer through a workspace. It offers a persistent working environment with features such as file sharing, browser control, and collaboration between AI agents.

snapshot.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.

items.title: hmjz100/LinkSwift
items.summary: JavaScript-based LinkSwift is a tool used to obtain direct file download links from eight different cloud storage services. Supporting various cloud platforms (such as Baidu, Alibaba Cloud, 123 Cloud), this software was developed based on an existing download helper project.

snapshot.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘. 基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 - 原作者: 油小猴 - 原仓库: - 本脚本发布至脚本猫: - 还有 OpenUserJS:

items.title: expo/skills
items.summary: expo/skills, developed by Expo, is a collection of skills that provides AI agents with the technical knowledge they need when working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services. This tool helps agents implement Expo APIs and workflows more accurately during application development processes.

snapshot.description: A collection of AI agent skills for working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services. Skills give AI agents focused Expo knowledge: when to use Expo APIs, how to structure common workflows, and which Expo, EAS, React Native, iOS, and Android constraints matter. Expo documentation, Expo CLI, and EAS CLI remain the source of truth; these skills help agents apply them correctly.

items.title: ruvnet/RuView
items.summary: RuView performs real-time spatial analysis, vital sign tracking, and asset detection using standard wireless network (WiFi) signals without the need for image data. Developed in the Rust language, this project aims to track movements and biometric data in an environment while minimizing hardware requirements.

snapshot.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.

items.title: xiaolai/the-craft-of-selfteaching
items.summary: xiaolai/the-craft-of-selfteaching is a guide prepared in Jupyter Notebook format that focuses on improving self-learning skills. It provides a resource aimed at helping individuals structure their learning processes and build their futures through this method.

snapshot.description: One has no future if one couldn't teach themself. 特别感谢霍炬（@virushuo）、洪强宁（@hongqn) 两位良师诤友在此书写作过程中给予我的巨大帮助！

items.title: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.summary: Eleven days after receiving notification that the security of the eMudhra certificate authority had been compromised, Apple continues to trust these dangerous certificates in the git, curl, and python3 tools that come with macOS. This situation poses a risk because these tools, which are part of the system's security infrastructure, accept unverified certificates.

snapshot.description: Eleven days after Apple was notified of the eMudhra CA compromise, the git, curl and python3 that Apple ships with macOS still trust the compromised certificates.

items.title: Why is this fingerprinting script creating bioweapons?
items.summary: An analysis published on Nullpt.rs reveals that browser fingerprinting scripts are unexpectedly gaining access to datasets related to biological weapons. The technical review details the vulnerabilities of such scripts and their potential risks to data privacy.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon, announced by Google, has been introduced as the company's newest artificial intelligence model. This model represents capabilities developed in line with Google's current technology research.

items.title: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch
items.summary: Apple has introduced the new MacBook Pro model, updated with PROLED XDR display technology and touch display hardware. The device aims to integrate innovations in display technology into its portable computer series.

snapshot.description: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/apple-unveils-groundb...

items.title: The Grid, a factory-scale robot in Massachusetts that builds PCBs on demand
items.summary: The Grid, based in Massachusetts, is a factory-scale robotic system that produces printed circuit boards (PCBs) on demand. This technology aims to complete circuit board production in half the time compared to standard rapid manufacturing centers.

snapshot.description: A factory-scale robot in Massachusetts that builds circuit boards on demand, in half the time of a typical Shenzhen quick-turn shop.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, published on Hugging Face, is an image-text-to-text model capable of processing visual and text-based data. Providing performance improvements in reasoning, coding, and agent-based tasks compared to the previous version, the model aims to increase cost efficiency by reducing processing time and output length.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B
items.summary: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B, shared on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Developers position this model as a high-capacity teacher agent to provide advanced agent capabilities to smaller-sized models.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. In Nanbeige4.3, we take a foundational step toward pushing the boundaries of lightweight agents. Our strategy centers on building a high-capacity teacher agent first, which will subsequently anchor the distillation of advanced agentic capabilities into smaller models.

items.title: RecursiveSI/flint
items.summary: RecursiveSI/flint is a mixture-of-experts language model developed for coding agents, featuring 39.8 billion total parameters and approximately 2.5 billion active parameters per token. This model is designed for examining codebases, debugging, adding new features, and writing tests.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Flint is Recursive’s mixture-of-experts language model for coding agents, with 39.8 billion total parameters and approximately 2.5 billion active per token. It is designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.

items.title: XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B
items.summary: Spark-X2.6-4B, published on Hugging Face, is an artificial intelligence model focused on text generation. Sharing the same architecture as its previous version, the model provides performance improvements in coding, reasoning, and multilingual capabilities thanks to post-training process enhancements.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Spark-X2.6-4B retains exactly the same architecture as Spark-X2.5-4B, achieving its capability gains through improved post-training. It delivers substantial improvements in coding, agent, long-context, multilingual, reasoning, etc. These advances enable more capable and practical on-device AI for developers and users tackling real-world tasks.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
items.summary: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, developed by MiniMaxAI, is a multimodal mixture-of-experts model focused on areas such as coding, cybersecurity, and computer usage. Supporting text, image, and video inputs, the model can process large datasets with a context window capacity reaching up to 1 million tokens.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model for coding, agentic workflows, computer use, and cybersecurity. It supports text, image, and video inputs with a context window of up to 1M tokens.

items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.summary: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success proposes offline methods instead of costly trials to evaluate the performance of robot foundation models. The study examines how motion trajectories, combined with visual and linguistic data, can strengthen the reality perception of artificial intelligence models.

snapshot.description: Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. items.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: TAO, shared by Hugging Face, is a joint scheduling framework developed to efficiently manage GPU and CPU resources in large language model (LLM)-based agent services. The system aims to reduce resource waste by optimizing transitions between model inference and external tool usage.

snapshot.description: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. items.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.summary: OmniShowcase is a method that aims to generate videos with object consistency using multiple reference images. It combines visual data from different perspectives to overcome the limitations of existing subject-to-video approaches, which struggle to predict the unseen parts of an object as the camera angle changes.

snapshot.description: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. items.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
items.summary: The article shared by Hugging Face presents a streaming-based method that extracts the target speaker using audio and visual data in real-world environments. The study aims to operate more efficiently on edge devices by overcoming the limitations of existing systems, such as high latency and hardware requirements.

snapshot.description: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. items.title: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: DTCA: Denoising Token Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models, shared by Hugging Face, aims to improve the reinforcement learning process in diffusion language models. The study introduces a new credit assignment method to determine the contribution of each token to the final output during the iterative denoising phase.

snapshot.description: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, enabling bidirectional context modeling and parallel token refinement. Recent studies have applied reinforcement learning (RL) to DLMs and improved their reasoning performance. However, the iterative denoising process makes credit assignment more challenging, as final outcome rewards provide limited information about how different tokens contribute to the final output. glossary.explanation: A comprehensive software tool that allows software developers to perform coding, editing, and debugging operations from a single location.
A set of fundamental building blocks and rules used to accelerate and standardize software development processes.
Specialized capabilities that can be added to or combined with each other for artificial intelligence agents to perform complex tasks.
A system architecture specifically designed for the direct use and management of artificial intelligence agents.
A learning process that enables the system to improve over time by continuously updating itself with new data.
A management system that allows companies to track their interactions with customers, communication history, and sales processes.
Artificial intelligence technology capable of generating new content such as text, images, or code in accordance with given commands.
The specific skill set that artificial intelligence uses when creating visual or interface designs.
A set of standard terms and visual rules that artificial intelligence agents use when designing.
The entirety of low-quality, unnecessary, or erroneous content generated by artificial intelligence.
A type of software whose source code is open for everyone to access, examine, and improve.
A digital workspace where the user can manage different artificial intelligence models and tools together.
A connection interface that allows different software programs to communicate and exchange data with each other.
A network technology that allows devices to connect to the internet or to each other wirelessly.
A method used by internet browsers to uniquely identify a user by collecting device information.
Hardware that allows interaction via a screen, which can be commanded by touch.
